# Math Calculator

> A REST API service for mathematical calculations with JSON responses and LaTeX notation support.

Math Calculator provides developers with a simple, unauthenticated REST API for performing mathematical operations. The service supports standard HTTP methods (GET/POST), CORS-enabled requests, and returns results in both JSON and LaTeX formats.

## Key Topics

- REST API
- JSON responses
- LaTeX notation
- HTTP methods (GET/POST)
- CORS support
- No authentication required
- Rate limiting
- Math Calculator API
- API documentation
- Quick start guide

## API Reference

- [API Documentation](https://mathcalculator.org/api-docs): Complete REST API documentation for Math Calculator with JSON responses and LaTeX notation support.
